title: Q10
description:
“Both He who sanctifies and those who are being sanctified are all of one.”
Read: Lev 20:8, Lev 21:8, Exo 31:13
a) In the Torah, Yahweh says “I am Yahweh who sanctifies you.” What does that background bring forward when Hebrews calls the Son “He who sanctifies” and also says He is “of one” with those He sanctifies?
